setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through the test MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, in C major, stopped. Clock Rate is /1 and no Swing or Shuffle is set. Channel 1 is selected and its Clock page is open. Your goal is to give channel 1 its own shuffle feel. Rate is the first row of a vertical list.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E2 left until Rate is selected, the first row (it reads /1, the default). The list shows Rate, Feel source and Swing type together, so you can read the channel's clock and feel settings at a glance.
steps.title: Read the Clock settings together

steps.caption: Tap K1 twice: the first tap opens the norns menu and the second closes it, and the page keeps your place. Turn E2 to Swing type. It reads X: this channel has no feel of its own yet.
steps.title: Select Swing type

steps.caption: Turn E3 left as far as it goes and press K3. It stays at X. X means this channel follows the global feel set in Song > Tempo and feel.
steps.title: Follow the global feel

steps.caption: Turn E3 right to Shuffle and press K3. Shuffle adds its own rows below Swing type for setting this channel's feel.
steps.title: Choose Shuffle

steps.caption: Keep turning E2 right. The list stops on its last row, Shuffle amount (0), and does not wrap round however far you turn.
steps.title: Reach the end of the list
